events.title: RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCED
events.summary: Howdy yall, the game is finally coming out!! Its been so fun working on this, and I learned so much in the past 2 years. This has been by far my biggest gamedev project, and although I'll miss it, I also look forward to working on new things, and developing my skills further. Its crazy to think that I went from minecraft command blocks, then I released 'grandmaster fruit' on itch.io, my first released game. And after a bunch of unfinished prototypes, now this!Anyways, the date is NOVEMBER 10th 2

events.title: BIG DEMO UPDATE
events.summary: Hello all, I've just released a new demo for the game that adds a bunch of new stuff, and some player requested features.The first level, Throne, has been completely redone. Players said the first was confusing, and didn't match up to the other levels in the game. The new level is much larger, less maze-like, and shows off the games style better. The feedback has been very helpful in designing the new level, however because it is new, new feedback is needed! So any thoughts are much appreciated.

events.title: THE BIOVERSE
events.summary: Hello all, if you've been following me on youtube (which btw you can find here )then you would know that I'm working on a new gamemode. It is called the bioverse, you must travel through the floors of a dungeon, which gets progressively larger and scarier the further you go. It goes forever, so see how far you can go!You unlock this mode from beating the full game - but I am looking to add it to the demo as well. In june, before steam next fest, expect a big revamp for the demo and this new game

events.title: Full game progressing!
events.summary: The full game is well underway, I am looking to release it around july or august. Many new cool levels and weapons await!!Until then, I have been regularly updating and polishing the demo. It now features fancy new weapon animations, a interactive main menu, and some balancing changes.I am still looking for more feedback, so please feel free to post your thoughts in the community tab. The game is only getting better!!Thanks for reading, there will be more updates soon. Be sure to wishlist if you

events.title: MASSIVE DEMO UPDATE
events.summary: MASSIVE UPDATE!!First off, I took in some feedback to improve the game. A lot of people complained about the floaty movement, so I've decided to sharpen it up. I personally really liked the slowness, but its obvious that not many agree. The movement is now tighter and more responsive.With that out of the way, there have been many little changes to balancing, and now the game is a bit harder. But the biggest new addition is a re-haul of floor 6: throne. It seemed too linear and boring to explore.

I am also proud to announce that my secret test level "THE CAGE" is now available for everyone to play!
